why: The launch-record writer must bridge WindowManager lifetime, AppServices state and the weak LaunchRecordHost adapter. The owner back-reference is weak, the service host is weak, and the captured BackgroundWork handle keeps off-main persistence alive without a retain cycle; moving this seam to a new target requires a separate host protocol and package edge.
